POWER MECHANICS — TERMLY EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: POWER MECHANICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Introduction to computer aided drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to computer aided drawing.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to computer aided drawing.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to computer aided drawing.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to computer aided drawing.

2. When learning Electrical Systems 3.2 Electronic Systems 3.3 Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 O, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Electrical Systems 3.2 Electronic Systems 3.3 Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 O.

   C. Skip safety briefings for Electrical Systems 3.2 Electronic Systems 3.3 Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 O.
